content.text:
The researcher wants company_owns_uni_academic_use (acceptable - we get ownership) and 6 months exclusivity (down from our 12). The academic use right is fine since we own the IP. 6 months exclusivity is shorter than we'd like but the field is narrow. This is close to acceptable. Let me accept - it meets our needs: company owns results, 60-day review, narrow exclusivity field, good milestones with contact role.

Actually, I should accept this. It meets our hard needs: company owns the results (embedded in BehaviorWatch), 60-day review, the university only gets academic use rights which won't hurt our competitive position. 6 months exclusivity is shorter but the field is narrow enough.
